Python typing and dataclasses

Types written in the code are read by a checker.

See

A type hint says what a value should be. Python does not enforce it at runtime.

A dataclass is a record with defaults. It is useful when a value has several named fields.

Fix

Run mypy on the file, then fix the error it reports.

Annotate the function and check it with mypy.

Keep

Types are documentation the checker reads.
